actions.action: Inspect pale specks with zoomed phone camera or magnifier
Wipe a speck with alcohol-dipped cotton swab to test if insect
Check leaf undersides, joints, and stems for sticky residue, webbing, or white clusters
Move plant a few feet back from the window glass
Alternatively hang a sheer curtain to filter direct sun
Move plant closer to window after a couple of weeks if doing well
Check top two inches of soil are dry before watering
Check roots if soil stays wet long
Trim mushy, dark, or smelly roots if found
Use a humidifier if air is dry
Alternatively set up a pebble tray
Isolate the plant if insects found
Wipe leaves with alcohol on cotton swab, weekly, if insects found
Alternatively spray insecticidal soap weekly if insects found
Alternatively apply neem oil weekly if insects found
Trim browned leaf tips with clean scissors following leaf shape
Take a closer, sharper photo of the spots
